    # Clamp result to [-1, 1] to ensure valid arcsin domain

    sin_theta2 = np.maximum(-1.0, np.minimum(1.0, sin_theta2))
    return sin_theta2

def formula(Q, delta_Q, P, delta_P):
    # Price Elasticity of Demand
    # Ed = (ΔQ/Q) / (ΔP/P)

    percent_change_P = delta_P / P
    Ed = percent_change_Q / percent_change_P
    return Ed

def formula(A, K, L):
    # Cobb-Douglas production function
    # A = Total Factor Productivity (TFP)
    # K = Capital input
    # L = Labor input

def formula(FC, P, VC):
    # Break-Even Point calculation
    # FC: Fixed Costs
    # P: Price per unit
    # VC: Variable Cost per unit
    contribution_margin = P - VC
    bep = FC / contribution_margin
    return bep
